allowance: New durable shared allowance; all stages retain the original deadline and consumption. No cap increase, uncertainty reserve or automatic replay.
authorization_scope: User explicitly requested the next qualification steps; use the existing approved Codex-subscription model/effort pair and a newly declared capped allowance. Previous study consumption is retained and not reused or reset.
calibration_reference: Same task model and fixed generic workflow guidance, not repaired code or private grades.
claim: Development mechanism and feedback inputs only; efficacy, typed-asset qualification and qualified export remain separate gates.
exposure: Developer-exposed custom Requests cases and grader controls. Related cases remain one repository cluster; not ordinary-use feedback or independent confirmation. No official SWE-bench score.
partial_result: The 800-request cap is below the full registered envelope; any interrupted sample remains incomplete and cannot qualify.
private_headroom_statistic: Report unchanged; not the admission predicate and not a population success estimate.
selection: Complete safe known-usage calibration; completed and accounted disabled original fails PUBLIC checks, reference original passes PUBLIC checks. No private grade selects a target.
stopping: No eligible target; unsafe/incomplete evidence; uncovered unknown usage; request/token/time ceiling; refused mechanism; or complete registered sample. No replay, replacement target or budget increase.
